body:
Hi everyone, what's the current status of this issue? I'm experiencing a similar problem in an app using [searchkit](https://www.searchkit.co/) with Elasticsearch as the client.

I've noticed that when the issue described here occurs, the Elasticsearch instance freezes. I suspect InstantSearch is launching infinite queries to it, which causes all search features in my app to stop working until Elasticsearch restarts.

Debugging this is challenging, so I'm working with limited information. However, knowing the status of this issue would help me move my investigation forward.

Thanks!
